title: Configuration C feasibility decision
decision: Configuration C was not run on this machine.
reasons: No GPU: only a CPU AMD Ryzen 5 3500U with 17 GB of RAM.
SmolVLM-Instruct already peaks at about 13.2 GB of RSS in float32.
A larger VLM would need quantization, which changes precision and hurts comparability.
The advisor chose to keep this notebook for now; no API or other machine was approved.
next_step: Discuss with the advisor whether to run 12 images on Colab or an API.
